necessity_paragraph: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and intermittent lightheadedness, raising concern for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation (I48.91) and other underlying cardiac arrhythmias (I49.9). Given the sporadic nature of these symptoms, standard ambulatory monitoring has been insufficient for capturing the rhythm disturbances. Mobile cardiac telemetry (CPT 93229) is ordered to provide continuous real-time monitoring and immediate alerting for significant arrhythmic events during the patient's daily activities.
